name: Volkheimeria
sum: Volkheimeria is a sauropod from the Early Jurassic of Chubut, Argentina, living about 179-178 million years ago.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: A partial cervical vertebra, dorsals, sacrum part, caudals, ilia, pubis, ischium, femur and tibia.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Bonaparte 1979
